gate_meanings.B0: approved inputs and reproducible real-model baseline established; not retrieval quality acceptance
gate_meanings.B1: comparison and human assessment complete; latency threshold violations and small-group uncertainty preclude general quality acceptance
gate_meanings.C0: observed development defects reproduced, corrected, regressions passed and version frozen; baseline recall/latency limitations explicitly retained
gate_meanings.C1: frozen independent FINAL collected and judged; POLICY03 errors, strict no-citation failures and latency limits retain fail; operating release withheld

operating_work: excluded by explicit human scope choice; not completed or approved
